public.label: CynolycusBot
public.summary: A research-first market decision system connecting causal data, specialist intelligence, controlled execution, and auditable operations.

local.details: The local view adds runtime ownership, storage, scheduling, recovery, and broker-boundary context without exposing credentials or account state.

public.label: Market + Context Inputs
public.summary: Bars, quotes, options, orders, news, filings, scheduled events, macro context, and stored research artifacts.

local.details: Inputs arrive through provider adapters or immutable local artifacts with event and availability timestamps.

public.label: Feature + Data Fabric
public.summary: Time alignment, universes, completed bars, causal features, caches, readiness, and shared safeguards.

local.details: Off-hours jobs refresh shared bars and matrices while job guards prevent overlap with fragile live windows.

public.label: Context Intelligence
public.summary: News, catalysts, events, guidance, themes, and social attention enrich specialist and meta decisions.

local.details: Context products are stored and joined by availability time; coverage and taxonomy history vary by source.

public.label: Specialist Strategies
public.summary: Intraday, swing, 4-hour ranking, dealer, and deterministic structure modules solve different decision problems.

local.details: Each module retains its own feature, inference, policy, and evidence boundary even when execution services are shared.
local.runtime_owner: Module runners and combined server schedules

public.label: Policy + Execution
public.summary: Strategy gates, sizing, routes, exits, broker reconciliation, persistent ownership, and audit.

local.details: Paper is the default. Live routes are separately gated and broker responses remain authoritative.

public.label: Research + Control
public.summary: Features, labels, training, out-of-fold and frozen evaluation, backtests, dashboards, scheduling, state, and recovery.

local.details: Operational controls expose health and audit state but do not turn research evidence into live authority.

public.label: Market + Broker Data
public.summary: Alpaca bars, quotes, options, and orders plus Schwab option chains.

local.details: Broker credentials and account payloads are outside the atlas.

public.label: Context Sources
public.summary: News, SEC filings, earnings, macro, rates, FINRA, CBOE, profiles, and public datasets.

local.details: Coverage depth and point-in-time availability differ across collectors.

public.label: Stored Artifacts
public.summary: Versioned parquet, CSV, JSON, JSONL, model bundles, policies, audits, and result locks.

local.details: Raw, processed, model-ready, inference, and audit stores remain separated by convention.

public.label: Time + Universe
public.summary: Market calendars, session boundaries, symbol universes, and decision-time alignment.

local.details: Every downstream feature depends on explicit session and availability semantics.

public.label: Bars + Aggregation
public.summary: One shared stream fans completed bars into strategy-specific timeframes and caches.

local.details: The combined server owns the single free-tier stream and bounded fan-out.

public.label: Causal Feature Construction
public.summary: Backward-looking rolling, exponentially weighted, ranked, and lagged context features.

local.details: Scalers, joins, and higher-timeframe mappings are fitted or shifted before validation/test/live application.

public.label: Readiness + Job Guards
public.summary: Freshness stamps, memory thresholds, single-flight protection, and fail-closed entry checks.

local.details: Heavy jobs are blocked during fragile live windows or under insufficient memory.

public.label: News + Catalysts
public.summary: Ingestion, deduplication, embeddings, tone, source quality, buzz, trajectory, and catalyst records.

local.details: Standalone claims remain limited by corpus coverage and historical availability.

public.label: Events + Forward Guidance
public.summary: Scheduled earnings, macro, SEC, and post-earnings guidance context.

local.details: The module is context and research, not an established standalone execution edge.

public.label: Dynamic + Legacy Themes
public.summary: Embedding clusters, LLM-assisted taxonomy, relationships, memberships, and legacy rotation context.

local.details: LLM output names taxonomy metadata; it does not select orders. Legacy maps remain live dependencies.

public.label: Social Attention
public.summary: Reddit/social collection, attention, sentiment, embeddings, and clustering MVP.

local.details: Historical population remains too limited for a defensible standalone edge.

public.label: Meta Context Matrix
public.summary: Combines specialist scores with liquidity, regime, themes, news, macro, Treasury, and guidance context.

local.details: Expanding-window OOF specialist predictions protect the training slice from in-sample score leakage.

public.label: SPY Intraday
public.summary: A 10-minute GA-XGBoost setup model followed by deterministic one-minute confirmation.

local.details: End-to-end live/replay plumbing exists, but recent live directional evidence is weak.

public.label: Multi-Ticker Swing
public.summary: A 30-minute cross-sectional swing classifier with strategy-specific live features and execution.

local.details: Research and live paths share feature logic; option execution remains a material risk boundary.

public.label: Momentum Expansion
public.summary: A 4-hour cross-sectional continuation ranker and selective expansion policy.

local.details: Shared readiness and execution infrastructure support scheduled ranking and managed exits.

public.label: HTF Swing Ranker
public.summary: A 4-hour cross-sectional swing ranker with a validation-selected long-only policy.

local.details: Top-K evidence is stronger than global calibration; artifact freshness remains explicit.

public.label: Meta Ranker
public.summary: Contextual quality and upside rankers combine specialist and contextual evidence.

local.details: Upside ranking is materially stronger than quality ranking; calibration remains imperfect.

public.label: Dealer Positioning
public.summary: Schwab-chain GEX/VEX levels, walls, magnets, and historical snapshots.

local.details: Short history prevents strong backtest claims; snapshot availability varies by symbol.

public.label: Dealer Ranker
public.summary: Ranks liquid optionable names from dealer structure and can route separately gated option/equity orders.

local.details: Contract liquidity, duplicate ownership, target notional, and live gates are explicit.

public.label: Intraday Structure
public.summary: A deterministic one-minute confirmation engine with persistent setup states, targets, and replay labels.

local.details: There is no broker-order interface. Thresholds remain uncalibrated against broad history.

public.label: Inputs
public.summary: Broad universe 4-hour bars plus lagged daily, weekly, benchmark, earnings, and liquidity context.

local.details: Shared bar caches and universe snapshots feed matrix construction.

public.label: Feature Engineering
public.summary: Causal 4-hour and lagged higher-timeframe feature families for cross-sectional continuation.

local.details: Feature manifests and readiness stamps protect inference parity.

public.label: Cross-Sectional Ranker
public.summary: Tree-based rank/classification models prioritize the strongest expansion candidates.

local.details: Top-K ranking evidence is more defensible than probability calibration.

public.label: Signal Selection
public.summary: Current candidates are ranked, filtered, freshness-checked, and audited before any plan is built.

local.details: Signal decisions record skips and inputs for later review.

public.label: Entry + Exit Policy
public.summary: Selective entry, explicit target notional, stop/target/scale/time policy, and paper-default routing.

local.details: Shared execution receives strategy-specific rankings and routing functions.

public.label: Shared 4H Execution
public.summary: Readiness, duplicate checks, sizing, route selection, exits, reconciliation, and persistent managed state.

local.details: State persists after order actions so sibling modules do not adopt fresh positions.

public.label: Audit + Evidence
public.summary: Walk-forward OOF, frozen policy tests, signal decisions, order intent, broker responses, and managed-state history.

local.details: Backtests and paper/live records remain separate evidence tiers.

public.label: Trend + Momentum
public.summary: Returns, moving-average structure, slopes, ADX, RSI, and MACD context.

local.details: Backward-looking windows only.

public.label: Volatility + ATR
public.summary: ATR, normalized ranges, realized volatility, compression, and expansion.

local.details: Also informs policy risk geometry.

public.label: Volume + Liquidity
public.summary: Volume, dollar liquidity, turnover, spread/tradability context, and cross-sectional ranks.

local.details: Eligibility and ranking remain distinct.

public.label: Relative Strength
public.summary: SPY/QQQ-relative returns and cross-sectional strength ranks.

local.details: Ranks use only the contemporaneously eligible universe.

public.label: Location + Structure
public.summary: Distance from highs, breakout location, drawdown, and persistence context.

local.details: Used to distinguish late chase from durable expansion.

public.label: Regime + Benchmarks
public.summary: Lagged market, volatility, rates, and benchmark context.

local.details: Availability alignment is explicit.

public.label: Daily + Weekly Context
public.summary: Lagged daily and weekly returns, trends, ATR, and survival context.

local.details: Higher-timeframe values are shifted before intraday mapping.

public.label: Inputs
public.summary: Thirty-minute bars, shorter execution context, benchmark bars, universe metadata, and lagged daily context.

local.details: Raw and processed stores remain distinct.

public.label: Feature Engineering
public.summary: Shared offline/live 30-minute trend, momentum, volatility, liquidity, relative-strength, and context features.

local.details: Live inference reuses the offline feature builder.

public.label: Swing Classifier
public.summary: Multiclass swing-zone probabilities and challenger ranking artifacts.

local.details: Frozen classifier and ranker artifacts are evaluated separately.

public.label: Rank + Confirmation
public.summary: Universe scanning, probability/rank filtering, freshness checks, and shorter-timeframe confirmation.

local.details: Entry price intent and broker fill are distinct audit events.

public.label: Swing Order Policy
public.summary: Direction, option/equity route, liquidity/expiry gates, target notional, ATR management, and position limits.

local.details: Sibling-owned positions are vetoed during broker reconciliation.

public.label: Execution + Reconciliation
public.summary: Strategy-specific position management, broker-authoritative state, exits, restore handling, and duplicate protection.

local.details: Ownership boundaries prevent cross-module adoption and flattening.

public.label: Audit + Evidence
public.summary: Frozen classifier/backtest evidence, replay trades, session records, option forensics, and policy experiments.

local.details: Directional signal quality and option execution quality are reported separately.

public.label: Trend + Momentum
public.summary: Returns, moving averages, slopes, oscillators, and continuation/reversal context.

local.details: Feature calculation is shared with live inference.

public.label: Volatility + ATR
public.summary: Range, ATR, volatility, compression, and move-normalization context.

local.details: ATR also anchors policy geometry.

public.label: Liquidity + Tradability
public.summary: Volume, dollar volume, gaps, spreads, and universe eligibility context.

local.details: Underlying and option-contract liquidity are separate gates.

public.label: Relative Strength
public.summary: SPY/QQQ-relative returns, beta context, and cross-sectional ranks.

local.details: Ranks are calculated on the eligible contemporaneous universe.

public.label: Swing Location
public.summary: Pivot zones, distance from highs/lows, breakout context, and recent run-up.

local.details: Labels and live features remain separate responsibilities.

public.label: Regime + Daily Context
public.summary: Lagged market, daily trend/ATR, earnings, sector, and benchmark context.

local.details: Daily context is persisted and refreshed outside the session path.

public.label: Shared 4H Engine
public.summary: Readiness, plan execution, sizing, duplicate checks, exits, persistence, and audit for 4-hour modules.

local.details: Injected ranking and routing keep strategy intelligence separate.

local.details: Supervision, watchdogs, readiness schedules, memory guards, persistent state, and recovery ownership.
